basics.name: Olatz Goti
basics.label: Web Developer passionate about technology and understanding how things work, looking for a job opportunity, either as an employee or self-employed.

summary.paragraph: I consider myself curious (so much so that my dream is to be a private detective), with good listening skills and initiative. I don't know everything, but my passion is solving problems, finding the necessary resources to extract information and coding a solution that improves the product or helps to make someone's work easier. I am realistic and thoughtful, eager to learn and delve deeper. I firmly believe in constant change based on a coherent vision, and in teams where trust and mutual learning are encouraged.

Committed to what I think and what I do, I work with focus and responsibility on each project, where I seek to contribute to the team with concrete solutions, thus contributing to this stage of change and growth that this profession entails, in a practical, realistic, and effective way.

My goal is to continue working in the development sector, deepen my knowledge and gain a greater understanding of the systems used. I also greatly value the creation of a community where we can share our progress and support each other, so feel free to connect with me.

work.name: Irontec
work.summary: I developed several utilities for an independent asset management and advisory tool, and also implemented various views and interfaces for the product. I applied the necessary styles to each component. I also took responsibility for the project, communicating with the client and ensuring that their needs were met.

work.name: Talent job BBK
work.summary: We developed a web applications for multiple users protected with Json Web Token called Talent job BBK using React, MongoDB, Node.js, express, Sass. Created structure with authentication, and storage. Developed design created by the marketing team creating responsive landing pages.
